nameEn: Manufacture of hard surface floor coverings
description: This class includes the manufacture of non-textile floor coverings.
includes: manufacture of linoleum, floor coverings with a linoleum base
manufacture of floor coverings of cork
manufacture of hard surface floor coverings of rubber, plastics
excludes: manufacture of ceramic flags and paving, see 2393
manufacture of carpet and rugs, see 1393
manufacture of wooden floor coverings, see 1621
